brief: 6 tools every indie hacker needs before writing a single line of code.

slots.tagline: Notion turns scattered ideas into a single source of truth before you open an IDE.
slots.f1Body: Write product requirements, user stories, and scope in one living document.
slots.f2Body: Track roadmap, content calendar, and bugs with flexible relational tables.
slots.f3Body: Share pages publicly or privately so everyone stays aligned from day zero.

slots.tagline: Figma lets you prototype the entire product so developers know exactly what to build.
slots.f1Body: Build responsive components that scale across devices without manual math.
slots.f2Body: Hand off CSS, spacing, and assets directly from the canvas to production.
slots.f3Body: Link screens into clickable flows to validate UX before writing any logic.

slots.tagline: Linear keeps your roadmap tight so you ship on schedule, not on hope.
slots.f1Body: Plan weekly sprints and quarterly goals with automatic progress tracking.
slots.f2Body: Branches and pull requests link to issues so status updates stay effortless.
slots.f3Body: Opinionated workflows mean you start tracking bugs in seconds, not hours.

slots.tagline: Supabase gives you a scalable database and auth without provisioning a single server.
slots.f1Body: Auto-generated REST and GraphQL endpoints hook into your frontend immediately.
slots.f2Body: Built-in user management and row-level security protect your data by default.
slots.f3Body: Deploy serverless TypeScript globally to handle webhooks and business logic.

slots.tagline: Stripe handles billing, subscriptions, and tax so you can focus on product-market fit.
slots.f1Body: Start accepting payments in minutes with prebuilt, conversion-optimized pages.
slots.f2Body: Model SaaS tiers, trials, and usage-based billing without custom invoicing code.
slots.f3Body: Automatic sales tax, VAT, and invoice generation keep you globally compliant.

slots.tagline: Vercel turns your repository into a global application with zero DevOps overhead.
slots.f1Body: Every commit triggers an instant preview deployment with live shareable URLs.
slots.f2Body: Static and dynamic content render close to users for sub-second page loads.
slots.f3Body: Real-world Web Vitals and performance scores are tracked out of the box.

slots.ctaBody: Wire your toolkit once and move from idea to revenue faster than ever.
